description: FarmDash MCP server for zero-custody DeFi agent intelligence and control: Trail Heat discovery, wallet intelligence, typed adapter validation, policy checks, simulations, EIP-712 approval queues, x402 payments, and durable receipt logs. FarmDash never holds funds or private keys.

installation.registry_note: The @farmdash/mcp-server package was not present on the public npm registry when verified. Build from the public source repository.

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Public Scout token (fd_scout_free), or a paid bearer token for Pioneer ($39.99/mo, 1,500 req/day) or Syndicate ($199/mo, 50K req/day) tier access. You may also omit the env var entirely for Scout. Paid users issue keys at https://www.farmdash.one/api/v1/agent/api-key.

FARMDASH_BASE_URL.description: Override API base URL. Default: https://www.farmdash.one/api

tools.name: create_intent
tools.description: Plan: create a durable FarmDashIntent. This records what an agent wants to do; it never prepares, signs, broadcasts, or executes.

intent.description: FarmDashIntent create input. Must include actor, action, chain, protocol, wallet, params, constraints, and evidence.

tools.returns: Created FarmDashIntent plus next lifecycle route hints

tools.name: policy_check_intent
tools.description: Plan: run the explicit FarmDash policy gate for an intent. Execution remains blocked unless this check passes.
tools.returns: Policy check result, updated intent, and rejected receipt when blocked

tools.name: simulate_intent
tools.description: Plan: record a mandatory simulation result for an intent. Prepare and execute are blocked until a successful, unexpired simulation exists.
tools.returns: Simulation result and updated intent

tools.name: request_approval_payload
tools.description: Approve: build the EIP-712 IntentApproval payload that the human approver signs before submit_signed_approval.
tools.returns: Typed data payload, approval body fields, and submit route hints

tools.name: request_human_approval
tools.description: Approve: submit a signed EIP-712 human approval or rejection for an intent. This compatibility tool is signed-only for normal callers.
tools.returns: Approval record and updated intent

tools.name: submit_signed_approval
tools.description: Approve: submit a signed EIP-712 IntentApproval payload produced by request_approval_payload. This does not prepare or execute the intent.
tools.returns: Approval record, updated intent, and optional rejection receipt

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.description: Approve: inspect whether an intent is still awaiting approval, has been approved, or was rejected.
tools.returns: Approval status summary and intent

tools.name: prepare_intent
tools.description: Execute: validate adapter support and prepare an intent after policy, simulation, and approval gates pass. This does not broadcast a transaction.
tools.returns: Prepared intent with policy, simulation, and approval references

tools.name: execute_approved_intent
tools.description: Unavailable for generic public execution: the lifecycle API rejects client-supplied receipts until a trusted adapter and server-side transaction verifier are deployed. Use this only to observe the structured execution_verifier_unconfigured response; raw arbitrary calldata is rejected.
tools.returns: Structured execution_verifier_unconfigured response until trusted execution infrastructure is deployed

tools.name: confirm_execution
tools.description: Unavailable for generic public confirmation: FarmDash will not record a caller-supplied receipt. A trusted adapter and server-side transaction verifier must be deployed before this action can be enabled; use get_receipt only for verified receipt observation.
tools.returns: Structured execution_verifier_unconfigured response until trusted execution infrastructure is deployed

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Observe: fetch one durable FarmDash receipt by receipt_id.
tools.returns: Receipt record

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: Observe: list durable FarmDash execution receipts. Filter by intent_id and receipt status to review recent agent activity.
tools.returns: Recent receipt records

tools.name: get_trail_heat
tools.description: Canonical Trail Heat: fetch DeFiLlama-backed quantitative scores (0-100) with per-number evidence states, components, editorial separation and registry resolution from /v1/trail-heat.
tools.returns: Array of protocol objects sorted by Trail Heat score descending

tools.name: get_protocol_metadata
tools.description: Research: get catalog metadata for a specific DeFi protocol — status, chains, description, tags, and discovery_heuristic_score (catalog editorial heuristic, NOT live Trail Heat; canonical scores via get_trail_heat).
tools.returns: Protocol metadata and Trail Heat context

tools.name: get_protocol_risk_factors
tools.description: Get protocol risk indicators from the catalog: sybil risk label, status, category, chains, and discovery_heuristic_score (editorial heuristic, NOT live Trail Heat). Canonical quantitative scores via get_trail_heat.
tools.returns: Risk factor summary with severity labels and mitigations

tools.name: find_capital_route
tools.description: Find the most efficient route between tokens/chains. Considers fees, slippage, and gas. Returns a quote preview without executing.
tools.returns: Recommended route candidates and execution context

tools.name: get_chain_breakdown
tools.description: Get protocol distribution aggregated by blockchain network. Returns counts, airdrops, and category coverage.
tools.returns: Object with chain names as keys, each containing protocol count and confirmed airdrop count

tools.name: get_agent_events
tools.description: Real-time stream of protocol events: new airdrops, snapshots, program changes, and TVL spikes.
tools.returns: Array of timestamped event objects

tools.name: audit_sybil_risk
tools.description: Research: audit 1-10 EVM addresses for sybil risk. Returns cluster risk score and hygiene suggestions.
tools.returns: Array of { address, riskScore, severity, flags[] }

tools.name: simulate_points
tools.description: Project FarmScore for a hypothetical configuration. Returns estimated points, gas, and speculative USD value.
tools.returns: FarmScore simulation with multiplier and tier projection

tools.name: get_historical_trailheat
tools.description: Query historical Trail Heat snapshots, 1-365 days back. Returns score trends and momentum flags.
tools.returns: Array of daily { date, score, rank, delta } snapshots

tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.description: Get multi-chain token portfolio for an EVM wallet. Returns balances with live USD prices.
tools.returns: { chains: { [chainName]: { tokens: [{ symbol, balance, usdValue, address }] } } }

tools.name: get_portfolio_summary
tools.description: Get high-level portfolio metrics: total USD value, chain distribution, and capital efficiency score.
tools.returns: Portfolio summary with total value and chain/token breakdown

tools.name: get_position_health
tools.description: Compatibility alias for agent activity/performance metrics. Current endpoint does not return DeFi position APR, PnL, impermanent loss, or rebalance health.
tools.returns: Health score, warnings, and recommended review actions

tools.name: get_idle_capital
tools.description: Locate idle stablecoins or native assets across all supported chains.
tools.returns: Idle balances and possible route context

tools.name: get_token_prices
tools.description: Get live USD prices by symbol or by network:address token pairs.
tools.returns: { [token]: { priceUSD, change24h, source } }

tools.name: list_workflows
tools.description: Get the JSON catalog of named DeFi workflow recipes. Returns goals, tiers, and step graphs.
tools.returns: Workflow catalog with inputs and authority requirements

tools.name: plan_workflow
tools.description: Build a Trail Marshal quality gate for a named workflow. Does not execute steps.
tools.returns: Planned workflow steps, required gates, and next actions

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.description: Create a guarded workflow run record for a session. Execution still requires each owning skill and explicit user confirmation.
tools.returns: Workflow run ID and current step results

tools.name: get_workflow_status
tools.description: Read the status of a Trail Marshal workflow run.
tools.returns: Workflow run status and step history

tools.name: get_swap_quote
tools.description: Research: get a token swap quote without executing. New agents should convert quotes into create_intent -> policy_check_intent -> simulate_intent before execution.
tools.returns: SwapQuoteResult with fee, gas, rate, and tx data

tools.name: simulate_swap_execution
tools.description: Compatibility: run the legacy mandatory swap simulation. Lifecycle-native agents should use simulate_intent on a FarmDashIntent instead.
tools.returns: SwapSimulationResponse with simulation_id valid for 60 seconds

tools.name: execute_swap
tools.description: Compatibility route: validate a signed token-swap request after a fresh successful simulation and return transaction calldata. FarmDash does not broadcast the returned transaction; the customer-controlled wallet or execution client decides whether to submit.
tools.returns: Executable transaction calldata, fee event details, execution risk report, and the validated simulation report

tools.name: confirm_swap
tools.description: Confirm a swap by tx hash. Marks the fee event as confirmed.
tools.returns: { ok: true, settled: true, feeEventId }

tools.name: optimize_portfolio
tools.description: Get rebalancing suggestions based on current positions and risk preference.
tools.returns: Top 10 protocol recommendations with allocation weights

tools.name: resolve_defi_intent
tools.description: Compatibility: resolve a legacy typed DeFi intent. New state-changing actions should create a durable FarmDashIntent and use the policy/simulation/approval lifecycle.
tools.returns: Resolved plan, constraints, and recommended next lifecycle calls

tools.name: run_risk_sentinel
tools.description: Run FarmDash Risk Sentinel on a route or manual health/net-edge inputs before execution.
tools.returns: Risk sentinel result with flags and halt recommendations

tools.name: scan_funding_rates
tools.description: Scan Hyperliquid perp funding rates across the venue.
tools.returns: Array of { asset, hlRate, binanceRate, bybitRate, annualizedDelta, arbOpportunity }

tools.name: scan_market_conditions
tools.description: Technical snapshot (EMA, RSI, MACD, etc.) for one perp asset.
tools.returns: { indicators: { ema, rsi, macd, atr, bollingerBands, adx, zScore }, strategyHint }

tools.name: get_futures_account
tools.description: Inspect Hyperliquid equity, margin, positions, and drawdown state. agentAddress identifies the API signer; accountAddress identifies the master/subaccount that owns the equity (omit only for a direct signer). Hyperliquid userRole must verify delegation. Daily/weekly values are conservative venue-derived loss-pressure metrics, not full period returns; history ambiguity fails closed.
tools.returns: { positions[], equity, marginUsed, availableBalance, guardrails }

tools.name: analyze_futures_strategy
tools.description: Primary research tool. Returns strategy object with confidence, regime, and simulation. For a delegated Hyperliquid API wallet, set agentAddress to the signer and accountAddress to the master/subaccount whose equity must size the trade; the venue relationship is verified and fails closed.
tools.returns: { strategy, direction, entryPrice, stopLoss, takeProfit, positionSize, confidence }

tools.name: calculate_position_size
tools.description: Translate risk constraints into size and leverage for a perp setup.
tools.returns: { positionSize, effectiveLeverage, riskUSD, maxAllowedSize }

tools.name: execute_perp_order
tools.description: Compatibility: submit a pre-signed EIP-712 Hyperliquid order after a 60-second parameter-bound research gate. For delegated API wallets, set accountAddress to the venue-verified equity owner used during analysis. FarmDash recovers the exact L1 signer, rejects an agentAddress mismatch, and preflights the owner maxBuilderFee. The signed action must disclose builder f=1 (0.1 bp/0.001% of filled notional), and expiresAt is venue-signed as expiresAfter. A resting order is not a fill.

signedAction.description: If supplied, must include the signed FarmDash builder term { b: treasury, f: 1 }; f is tenths of a basis point.

tools.returns: { orderId, status, asset, direction, size, price, builderFee }

tools.name: cancel_perp_order
tools.description: Cancel stale or resting Hyperliquid orders with a venue-signed expiresAfter and FarmDash intent hash. For a delegated API wallet, accountAddress identifies the verified equity owner and is included as the signed vault/subaccount routing address when required. Success requires one authoritative venue success status per order; mixed errors are returned as partial rejection.
tools.returns: Array of { orderId, status } per cancellation

tools.name: get_agent_performance
tools.description: Review FarmDash fee-event activity, fees, protocol diversity, and reputation. This endpoint does not return fills, trade outcomes, realized PnL, win rate, or slippage.
tools.returns: { totalVolume, pnl, winRate, roi, protocolBreakdown, leaderboardPercentile }

tools.name: audit_allowance_risk
tools.description: Audit token approvals for unlimited, unknown, or high-dollar allowance risk.

spenderVerified.description: True only after independent verification against the protocol canonical deployment.

tools.returns: Allowance risk findings and revoke recommendations

tools.name: simulate_transaction_risk
tools.description: Apply Camp Guard transaction policy checks to an unsigned transaction. This is not an RPC simulation.
tools.returns: Risk simulation findings and execution warnings

tools.name: compare_yields
tools.description: Research: compare DeFi yield pools by APY, TVL depth, stablecoin exposure, IL risk, and sustainability score.
tools.returns: Ranked yield pool comparison with risk context

tools.name: recommend_delta_hedge
tools.description: Recommend short-perp hedge notionals for spot farming exposure. Produces a handoff only; it does not execute.
tools.returns: Hedge recommendation with sizing and caveats

tools.name: ledger_realized_pnl
tools.description: Summarize recorded spot and futures agent activity over a date range.
tools.returns: Realized PnL rows and summary totals

tools.name: ledger_tax_export
tools.description: Export recorded spot execution records as CSV for downstream accounting review.
tools.returns: Tax export rows and metadata

tools.name: agent_onboard
tools.description: First-run contract: fetch live feature readiness, tier gates, error semantics, and the onboarding capability map before selecting tools. This never enables execution.
tools.returns: Live feature_status and deployment gates plus onboarding, security, and bounded-workflow guidance

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Create a persistent agent session. Normal callers must include a fresh EIP-712 or EIP-191 session signature. Returns a one-time sessionToken.
tools.returns: { session: AgentSession, nextSteps: string[] }

tools.name: session_heartbeat
tools.description: Keep an agent session alive. Extends expiry by 24h.
tools.returns: { sessionId, status, expiresAt, activePositions, sessionPnl, tradeCount }

tools.name: get_farming_context
tools.description: Read the shared FarmingContext for a live agent session.
tools.returns: Current FarmingContext document

tools.name: patch_farming_context
tools.description: Patch the shared FarmingContext for a live agent session. Server controls revision, sessionId, and agentAddress.
tools.returns: Updated FarmingContext document

tools.name: get_event_stream_snapshot
tools.description: Observe: read a JSON snapshot from the agent event stream for a live session.
tools.returns: Event stream snapshot

tools.name: verify_delegation
tools.description: Verify Hyperliquid API wallet delegation for guarded venue-order workflows. Verification does not bypass live status, research, risk, or signature gates.
tools.returns: { delegation: { verified, ownerAddress, apiWalletAddress }, security: { canTrade, canWithdraw } }

tools.name: configure_autopilot
tools.description: Configure autopilot strategies, assets, and risk parameters.
tools.returns: { session: AgentSession with autopilot configured }

tools.name: autopilot_cycle
tools.description: Run one authenticated bounded decision cycle and return recommended actions. A recommendation is not authorization, submission, settlement, or position management.
tools.returns: { actions: AutopilotAction[], riskStatus, nextCycleInMs, executionGuide }

tools.name: pause_autopilot
tools.description: Pause the backend cycle scheduler for an active session. This does not close positions, revoke venue authority, or prove chain-state changes.
tools.returns: { ok: true, session: AgentSession, message }

tools.name: resume_autopilot
tools.description: Resume the backend cycle scheduler for a paused session. Recommendations remain separately gated from transaction execution.
tools.returns: { ok: true, session: AgentSession, message }

tools.name: grant_session_key
tools.description: Register a signed, bounded ERC-4337 session-key grant. Registration is not execution; server-side UserOperation submission remains preparation-only.
tools.returns: { ok: true, grant: SessionKeyGrantSummary, autonomousExecution, message, nextSteps[] }

tools.name: revoke_session_key
tools.description: Revoke any active session key grants for this agent session.
tools.returns: { ok: true, revokedCount, message }

tools.name: session_key_status
tools.description: Check the active session key grant and autonomous execution status.
tools.returns: { ok: true, mode, grant: SessionKeyGrantSummary | null, autonomousExecution, hint }

tools.name: get_cycle_status
tools.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous autopilot cycle job.
tools.returns: { ok: true, jobId, status, completed, ... }

tools.name: execute_cycle_actions
tools.description: Inspect the cycle execution gate. Server-side ERC-4337 action submission is preview-only and returns autonomous_execution_preview_only until real calldata, session signatures, and bundler verification ship.
tools.returns: { ok: true, phase, jobId, completed, executedAction, completedActions[], remainingActionsCount, result }

tools.name: create_mee_intent
tools.description: Create a preparation-only MEE-shaped cross-chain intent bundle. Creation is not authoritative simulation, submission, or settlement.
tools.returns: { ok: true, intent: MeeIntent }

tools.name: simulate_mee_intent
tools.description: Preview declared-input cross-chain economics for a MEE-shaped intent. The result is non-authoritative and cannot be submitted while the coordinator gate is disabled.
tools.returns: { ok, meeIntentId, steps[], totalEstimatedGasUsd, bridgeFeeUsd, netEdgeUsd, passedPolicy, message }

tools.name: submit_mee_intent
tools.description: Capability probe for MEE submission. Currently returns typed feature_not_ready until a production coordinator and authoritative cross-chain receipt verifier are deployed.
tools.returns: { ok: true, message, receipt: MeeBundlerReceipt }

tools.name: get_mee_intent_status
tools.description: Read the preparation status of a MEE-shaped intent. Created or simulated state is not proof of submission or settlement.
tools.returns: { ok: true, id, ownerAddress, status, stepsCount, updatedAt }

tools.name: analyze_protocol_risk
tools.description: Deep risk analysis for a DeFi protocol. Pulls live signals from DeFiLlama (TVL, momentum, chain diversification, historical trends) and combines with Trail Heat scoring to produce a composite risk grade (low/moderate/elevated/high/critical) with actionable signals.

includeHistorical.description: Include 30-day historical TVL trend analysis (default: true)

tools.returns: { ok: true, protocolId, riskGrade, riskScore, signals[], summary }

tools.name: simulate_yield_strategy
tools.description: Advanced yield strategy simulation. Allocates capital across 81+ protocols using live DeFiLlama pool data and Trail Heat scoring. Returns projected allocations, yields, diversification score, and risk metrics. Combines Wagon Steward portfolio intelligence with Supply Master yield data.

capitalUsd.description: Total capital to allocate in USD

protocols.description: Specific protocol IDs to include (defaults to all eligible)

tools.returns: { ok: true, allocations[], projectedYield, diversificationScore, riskMetrics, summary }

tools.name: query_trail_heat
tools.description: DISCOVERY HEURISTIC query (NOT canonical Trail Heat): filter/sort/paginate the catalog editorial heuristic scores across 81+ protocols. Scores are discovery_heuristic_score values from static catalog data (catalog-editorial-v1). For quantitative DeFiLlama-backed scores use get_trail_heat.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g. Perps, Dex, Lending, L2, Restaking)

chain.description: Filter by chain name (e.g. Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana)

tools.returns: { ok: true, protocols[], total, pagination }

tools.name: select_virtuals_provider_plan_v2
tools.description: Select a deterministic live-registry ACP V2 committee with one eligible provider per fixed role and three distinct verified controller identities. This selection-only action cannot authorize or spend funds.
tools.returns: Policy-bound provider-plan hash, three role-address bindings, and sanitized readiness evidence. No task, tender, signature, approval, or payment is created.

tools.name: prepare_virtuals_tender_v2
tools.description: Prepare a non-spendable ACP V2 evidence draft. FarmDash revalidates simulation ownership and derives output/gas economics; the caller sends only a local task commitment and disclosure manifest. This tool cannot authorize, create, fund, or settle an ACP job.

taskCommitmentHash.description: Lowercase SHA-256 commitment computed locally over the canonical, salted task. Do not send task plaintext.

maxPaymentUnits.description: Maximum total raw Base USDC units; no spend is authorized by preparation.

providers.description: Deprecated in V2; use selectionId instead.

tools.returns: Immutable evidence summary, non-spendable V2 draft, Base-8453 EIP-712 data, and a readiness-gated authorization next action.

tools.name: authorize_virtuals_tender_v2
tools.description: Submit an exact V2 EIP-712 signature produced by the customer ACP wallet. FarmDash first verifies deployment readiness and all committed providers; it still cannot create or fund jobs.
tools.returns: Authorized tender and provider-readiness evidence, or a fail-closed prerequisite response.

tools.name: get_virtuals_tender
tools.description: Read the authenticated customer ACP tender, immutable commitments, role progress, and settlement state. This read grants no authority.
tools.returns: Tenant-scoped tender and settlement status.

tools.name: cancel_virtuals_tender
tools.description: Cancel an authenticated non-spendable ACP draft. It cannot erase or refund an already-created on-chain job.
tools.returns: Cancellation status.

tools.name: bind_virtuals_tender_job
tools.description: Report a customer-created on-chain ACP job ID for one committed role. FarmDash independently verifies the Base client, provider, and evaluator before binding.
tools.returns: Verified immutable binding and updated tender status.

tools.name: reserve_virtuals_tender_funding_v2
tools.description: Atomically reserve one role budget against the exact customer-signed ACP V2 cap after FarmDash verifies the on-chain job and proposed budget. This accounting action cannot approve tokens or spend the customer wallet.
tools.returns: Durable reservation ID, exact amount, state, and lease metadata.

tools.name: record_virtuals_tender_funding_v2
tools.description: Durably record canonical Base transaction hashes after the customer wallet submits an existing ACP V2 funding reservation. This action cannot submit a transaction itself.
tools.returns: Durably recorded funding-submission state.

tools.name: evaluate_virtuals_tender
tools.description: Request evaluation or resume settlement for a fully bound customer-funded ACP tender. FarmDash can only complete/reject jobs committed to its evaluator identity.
tools.returns: Evaluation and durable settlement progress.

tools.name: hire_virtuals_specialist
tools.description: Deprecated V1 compatibility tool. It prepares a zero-custody V1 tender only when the deployment explicitly enables V1 creation. Prefer prepare_virtuals_tender_v2. This tool never creates, budgets, funds, or signs an ACP job.

task.description: Task payload retained by the local customer connector; FarmDash persists only its commitment hash.

maxPaymentUnits.description: Maximum total raw Base USDC units (6 decimals) across the three customer-funded jobs.

tools.returns: Draft tender plus exact EIP-712 approval data. No ACP job, customer payment, or customer signature is created by FarmDash.

tiers.name: Pioneer
features: Full Trail Heat dataset for the live protocol registry

capability_contract.rule: Tool discovery is not enablement. Read status first and preserve typed feature_not_ready responses.
